title: Gray Glass Mosaic Kitchen Backsplash
summary: Finished kitchen backsplash featuring a gray glass mosaic pattern coordinated with dark wood cabinets and light countertops.
problem: The kitchen needed a finished backsplash that would protect the wall and complement the existing cabinets, counters and appliances.
solution: Installed a glass mosaic backsplash across the main countertop walls, around outlets and behind cooking and preparation areas, with clean transitions at corners and cabinet edges.
